sources.snippet: Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data. sources.snippet: SmolVLA's architecture is designed for efficient training and inference without compromising the success rate. In addition, we propose an asynchronous inference stack that enables faster adaptation and responsiveness in real-world manipulation tasks.

sources.title: SmolVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Robotics
sources.snippet: SmolVLA offers a compact vision-language-action robotics model trained on community data, enabling efficient training and rapid deployment on affordable hardware.
